audit.whatIsWrong: Both layers gave Yone Levels 2-3 and called Levels 1 and 4-5 Skill, while whys[0] through whys[3] all say Wukong wins those four rows ('Levels 1-2 belong to you', 'Levels 3-4 you keep pressing').
audit.why: packet.levelChart is Wukong for rows 0-3, Skill at Level 6, Yone from first item on — exactly what the content prose already describes. No mirror exists yet, so this sets the reference for yone__wukong.
audit.corrected: Rows 0-3 set to Wukong as matched phases[N].side + win[N] pairs, all seven ratings normalised, and the stage explanations rewritten to name the mechanic behind each row.

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[4].why was the generic Cyclone line, phases[5].why said only 'Black Cleaver is your spike' on a row Yone owns, and phases[6].why quoted a carry-threat number.
audit.why: Fate Sealed is 120/100/80s at 1000 range and blinks behind the last champion in a line, pulling everyone hit toward him — that is why Level 6 is even and why Cyclone is the answer rather than the opener. Yone's real spike is his first crit or on-hit item, and two items give him two dashes plus that pull.
audit.corrected: Level 6 stage now describes Fate Sealed's behaviour; the first-item stage names the crit/on-hit breakpoint as his; the 2+ item stage names the two dashes and the 1000-range pull.

audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull[2] 'E-Q burst at his E return', dontsFull[1] 'Fight during his E burst' and dontsFull[2] 'Chase his dashes' all carried bodies copied from other rows. packet.defects also notes the page never names Mortal Steel, Spirit Cleave or Fate Sealed.
audit.why: Riot's text: Soul Unbound leaves his body behind and forces his spirit back to that body when it ends, repeating a portion of the damage he dealt — so the return point is known in advance and the return itself hurts. Mortal Steel is a flat 4s that dashes him forward on the second stack. Spirit Cleave is a 14s shield that grows with each champion hit.
audit.corrected: dosFull[0].d and breakdown.cooldowns now carry Soul Unbound's 22s and the body-return rule, Spirit Cleave's 14s shield and Fate Sealed's 120s pull; dosFull[2].d says to stand on his body; dontsFull[1].d states the repeated damage; dontsFull[2].d states the 4s second-stack dash. The three missing ability names now appear.

edits.before: Q-AA poke wins the short exchanges. Identify how Yone contests the first waves before you commit anything.
edits.after: Mortal Steel is a 4s poke with no knock-up until two stacks — walk through it and win the Level 1 exchange.

edits.before: W clone bails out any misstep and baits his answer. Only take the trade when Yone's Soul Unbound is down.
edits.after: Still ahead at 2: no Soul Unbound yet, so he cannot leave his body to slip out once your combo starts.

edits.before: Full kit online — your core pattern starts now. Keep the wave near your side so Yone must walk into your engage range.
edits.after: Full kit online and yours out-trades his: Spirit Cleave shields him on 14s, so trade again before it comes back.

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around Soul Unbound's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: Still yours: Soul Unbound is 22s at rank 1, so once he spends it there is a long stretch where he cannot slip your all-in.

edits.before: Cyclone’s double knockup wins every committed brawl. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Yone's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Even at 6: Fate Sealed blinks behind the last champion in line and drags you back — hold Cyclone as the answer, not the opener.

edits.before: Black Cleaver is your spike — force fights the moment it completes, on Soul Unbound's cooldown.
edits.after: His first crit or on-hit item pushes his sustained damage past your burst window.

edits.before: Two items on: your side-lane pattern is at full power. Yone carry threat 9/10 — close before the map decides instead of you.
edits.after: Two items on: two dashes, mixed damage and a 1000-range Fate Sealed mean he picks the fights, so play for the team.

edits.before: - Yone Soul Unbound: matchup-defining — He snaps back when it ends. Burst there. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Soul Unbound: 22s at rank 1, and his spirit is forced back to his body — stand on it. - Spirit Cleave: a 14s shield that grows with every champion hit. - Fate Sealed: 120s at rank 1 and it pulls you to him.

edits.before: He snaps back when it ends. Burst there. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: 22s at rank 1, and his spirit snaps back to his body — burst him there.

edits.before: Yone wastes Soul Unbound — commit the full pattern immediately.
edits.after: He always returns to where his body stood — be standing on it.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Soul Unbound repeats a share of the damage he dealt when it ends.

edits.before: Burning W before the trade starts — the clone IS your defense, and committing without it means eating his full combo.
edits.after: Mortal Steel dashes him forward on the second stack every 4s — chase it and you walk straight into the next knock-up.
